review_findings: The write guard is an adapter over the existing ChangePermit chain, not a successor or peer authority.
Exact request paths are checked before Provider effects and are checked again by concrete Provider policy.
Generic write authority explicitly excludes merge, preserving the stronger independent merge boundary.
The Human Gate adapter owns only gate/decision representation and delegates sequence, wait/resume, and lifecycle to existing runtime owners.
The explicit decision authoring command removes hand-written JSON without making Host commands an authority.
Product source, Quality, completion, release, production, and merge code are outside the approved scope.

skill_rule_mappings.assessment: both supported Hosts use the same concrete factory and adapters
the adapter calls repair_governance.load_chain and permit_path_decision instead of interpreting a second permit format
missing identity, permit, exact paths, or supported capability raises before effects
gate and decision artifacts are persisted and bound to the same runtime identity
all generated state stays under .harness or governance and is not a production dependency
